 The I Play Rocky cast reveals what it took to recreate the original Rocky fight, from learning precise boxing choreography to revisiting iconic filming locations. 
 Anthony Ippolito, Stephan James, Kiki Seto, and AnnaSophia Robb join Collider to discuss bringing the making of Rocky back to life in Peter Farrelly's I Play Rocky.
